description: This source file defines the 'Visit' class in the OpenMRS healthcare platform. The class models a patient visit, including details such as patient information, visit type, location, start and stop dates, associated encounters, and attributes. It integrates with JPA/Hibernate annotations to map the class to the 'visit' database table.

classes.name: Visit
classes.description: Represents a patient's visit, including details like patient, type, location, dates, encounters, and attributes.

methods.name: getVisitId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the visit.

methods.name: setVisitId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the visit.

methods.name: getPatient
methods.description: Returns the patient associated with this visit.

methods.name: setPatient
methods.description: Sets the patient for this visit.

methods.name: getVisitType
methods.description: Returns the type of the visit.

methods.name: setVisitType
methods.description: Sets the type of the visit.

methods.name: getIndication
methods.description: Returns the indication concept associated with the visit.

methods.name: setIndication
methods.description: Sets the indication concept for the visit.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the location where the visit took place.

methods.name: setLocation
methods.description: Sets the location for the visit.

methods.name: getStartDatetime
methods.description: Returns the start date and time of the visit.

methods.name: setStartDatetime
methods.description: Sets the start date and time of the visit.

methods.name: getStopDatetime
methods.description: Returns the end date and time of the visit.

methods.name: setStopDatetime
methods.description: Sets the stop date and time of the visit.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the visit (overrides interface method).

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the visit (overrides interface method).

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the visit.

methods.name: getEncounters
methods.description: Returns all encounters associated with this visit.

methods.name: setEncounters
methods.description: Sets the encounters associated with this visit.

methods.name: getNonVoidedEncounters
methods.description: Returns a list of encounters that are not voided.

methods.name: addEncounter
methods.description: Adds an encounter to this visit and sets the encounter's visit reference.
